enchantments.tooltip: Repair Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming repair healing by +53 (Enhancement bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Greater Auto-Repair: This item has a small percentage chance to cast a Reconstruct spell on you when you take damage.
Damage Reduction 30/Adamantine: Reduces physical damage by 30, except from Adamantine attacks.
Maker's Touch: Casting a Repair spell on yourself or allies leaves a lingering defensive buff that increases the AC and Physical Resistance Rating of your target by +3 for 12 seconds.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
